parameters.content:
## Setup (once) - Ads Settings
Fill the account IDs you use (leave the others empty): `meta_ad_account_id` (without act_), `meta_pixel_id` (needed for Leads/Sales objectives), `tiktok_advertiser_id`, `snap_ad_account_id`, `google_ads_customer_id` (+ `google_ads_login_customer_id` if you use an MCC), `google_ads_developer_token`, `currency`, `approval_email`.

**Credentials**
- **Meta Graph API (Ads)**: System User token with `ads_management, ads_read`.
- **TikTok Business API**: Header Auth, name `Access-Token`, value = your TikTok for Business token.
- **Snapchat Marketing API**: OAuth2 - Auth URL `https://accounts.snapchat.com/login/oauth2/authorize`, Token URL `https://accounts.snapchat.com/login/oauth2/access_token`, scope `snapchat-marketing-api`.
- **Google Ads**: n8n Google Ads OAuth2 credential + developer token.
- **Gmail**: approval emails.

**Safety**: new campaigns are always created PAUSED. Daily optimisations are only applied after you click Approve in the email, and budget moves are capped by `max_budget_change_pct`.
